job.title: [Post] Dimpal G. - SAP Jobs
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Thank you for sharing these SAP openings – I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) development at Rockwell Automation and Shell and would like to be considered for a matching role.

– Java/Spring and OCC REST APIs
– PIM / ERP / MDM integrations
– SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for your client.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years building, extending and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C platforms (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, OCC REST web services for headless commerce, PIM / ERP / MDM integrations, SQL and FlexibleSearch tuning. Hands-on with Promotions Engine, OMS, Cronjobs, Impex, Backoffice and HAC; executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 and supports production. Techno-functional with business stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: I am looking for an SAP Commerce Cloud role in Germany where deep platform and integration experience creates real value for the client. Your network of SAP projects is a strong route to such a role, and I am glad to share my CV for any SAP Commerce or Hybris position you are filling. I look forward to contributing.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Dimpal, thanks for your SAP jobs post. I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer, 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, based in Karlsruhe, Germany, start 16.12.2026. Happy to share my CV!

en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
en.hook: Thank you for sharing these SAP openings. If any of them needs SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, I bring more than five years of it: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build and extend Hybris 2105 and 2211 platforms with Java and Spring, from OCC APIs to PIM / ERP / MDM integrations – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented product, catalog, pricing and customer data functionality on Hybris 2211; developed Promotions Engine, OMS, Cronjobs and Impex.

bullets.label: Headless APIs
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST web services for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Integrations
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; resolved bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee.

bullets.label: Delivery & support
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led query refactoring for lower latency, performed code reviews and mentored junior developers.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit and can start at your client on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation to show you the concrete contribution I can make to your team.
